<title level="1" right="Rules">[Damaging a Graft](/Rules.aspx?ID=3278)</title>

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 97

<row gap="medium">
<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">
Once a graft is accepted, it becomes part of the subject’s body and can’t take damage separately, just like any natural body part. If a graft is ever severed from the subject’s body, it can be reconnected by any method that allows a severed body part to be reattached (such as the [_regenerate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1648) spell). If the graft is destroyed before it can be reattached, the subject typically can’t restore it.
</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>
